record.paper: On graph classes with constant domination-packing ratio

dossier_meta.paper: On graph classes with constant domination-packing ratio
dossier_meta.statement_text: Given a graph class $\mathcal{G}$, is there a constant $c_{\mathcal{G}}$ such that $$\frac{\gamma(G)}{\rho(G)}\leqslant c_{\mathcal{G}}\quad\text{ for each }\quad G\in\mathcal{G}~{}~{}?$$
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper studies the ratio between the dominating number $\gamma(G)$ and the packing number $\rho(G)$ of a graph $G$. A positive answer immediately gives the bound $c_{\mathcal{G}}$ on the integrality gap of both the dominating and the packing integer programs for any $G\in\mathcal{G}$.
